mainEntity.name: Should I insulate my metal RV garage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Insulating your RV garage is highly recommended if you plan to store your vehicle long-term, use the space as a workshop, or protect onboard plumbing and sensitive electronics from extreme temperature swings. Uninsulated metal buildings can generate condensation on the ceiling during temperature shifts, which can drip onto your vehicle’s roof. Options range from simple reflective vapor barriers that control condensation to spray foam or thick fiberglass batts that maintain moderate interior temperatures during winter freezes and hot summer months.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, insulation prevents ceiling condensation drips, protects onboard RV plumbing and electronics from freezing or extreme heat, and makes the space usable as a workshop.
